Für normalen Rennbetrieb und deine bishe: For normal racing and your existing customizations. No additional bot watchdog is installed.
Dieselbe V339-Basis mit Flatouts Erweite: The same V339 baseline with Flatout’s extension for software-driven cars: throttle per car, lane changes and return to the hand controller. A watchdog sets bot throttle to 0 if control commands stop arriving.
Nur wenn deine Rennsoftware dieses Bot-M: Only if your racing software explicitly supports this bot module. The module alone does not create automatic opponents in RaceHubOS.
V339 besitzt bereits eigene Befehle für: V339 already has commands for software-driven cars, so the extra bot module is not always necessary. “Revision 5” is the bot extension version, not newer Carrera firmware or new CU hardware.
Hardware 8/STM32 wird damit nicht unters: Hardware 8/STM32 is not supported here. “Load baseline” loads a local file; it does not read firmware from the connected CU.

Rundenerkennung: Mindestabstand der Sens: Lap detection: minimum interval between sensor events
Serienwert 501 ms (CU-Zeitbasis laut Ups: Stock value: 501 ms (CU time base according to upstream). Applies per car between sensor events, including split times. RaceHubOS minimum lap time is configured separately. Higher: filters closely spaced events more strongly. Lower: accepts shorter intervals, including unintended duplicate signals.
Serienwert 5 CU-Ticks. Ändert die Wieder: Stock value: 5 CU ticks. Changes when both sensors are re-armed during pulse capture and after interference. Low values may allow duplicate events. There is no reliable general conversion to ms. Higher: waits longer for a quiet signal before re-arming. Lower: ready sooner, but may be more sensitive to interference.
Nur mit Bot-Modul .5. Ohne rechtzeitigen: Only with bot module .5. Without a timely B throttle command, bot throttle is set to 0. Stock value: 13 track cycles (about 1 s), assuming about 75 ms per cycle. The sender must update more often. The watchdog stays active. Lower: stops bot throttle sooner after a connection problem; short delays may also trigger it. Higher: allows later commands but reacts more slowly to failure. This control applies only to the extra bot module.
Vorhandene CU-Energiespareinstellung gil: The existing CU power-saving setting applies; the CU may sleep after prolonged inactivity.
Die neue Firmware überspringt den Eintri: The new firmware skips entry into sleep when no fault is detected. Short-circuit/overload detection, fault shutdown and fault blinking remain unchanged in code. The global keep-awake setting is not forced. USB/Bluetooth connection status is irrelevant. This does not disable the bot watchdog.
Es gibt hier keinen Schalter zum Abschal: There is no switch here to disable short-circuit or overload protection. Verification confirms unchanged protection code; no physical short-circuit test has been performed.
Aus: Die angepasste Firmware unterdrückt: Off: the custom firmware suppresses beeps through the sound queue, including during Bluetooth or USB connections. This may also suppress notifications and warnings from that routine. On: original sound routine and existing CU sound setting. This switch changes only the exported file; the connected CU changes only after a separate flash. Other sound paths are not guaranteed.

Die CU darf bei erfassten Überfahrten, R: The CU may play its existing tone sequences for detected crossings, laps and best times.
Diese Tonaufrufe werden unterdrückt; Run: These tone calls are suppressed; lap detection, timing and ranking calculations remain unchanged. Other tone calls remain available while “Allow CU beeps” is on. With beeps globally off, this extra switch has no audible effect. Global mute still suppresses warning tones from the same sound routine.
Serien-Fahrzeugsteuerung per PC zulassen: Allow stock PC car control (C command)
Kompatible Rennsoftware darf die vorhand: Compatible racing software may use the existing V339 PC commands for throttle and lane changes.
C-Steuerbefehle werden ohne Wirkung quit: C control commands are acknowledged without effect; software-driven cars using them will not work. Hand controllers, timing and software START/ESC remain unchanged. The extra bot module uses a different command and is not disabled by this switch. This is not a general emergency-stop or access lock.
Was machen Erstellen, Zurücksetzen und S: What do Create, Reset and Save do?
Setzt nur die Regler und Schalter im Edi: Resets only the editor controls and switches. A selected bot baseline remains a bot baseline; the running CU is not reset.
Berechnet eine neue HMF-Datei und den Pr: Calculates a new HMF file and inspection report from the selected settings. It does not transfer firmware to the CU.
Lädt die neue HMF für eine spätere Übert: Downloads the new HMF for a later transfer.
Enthält Einstellungen, Dateihashes und d: Contains settings, file hashes and changed locations. A successful file check is not a hardware test.
CU-Piepton: Firmware-Schalter und normal: CU beeps: firmware switch and normal CU setting
Oben lässt sich die Tonwarteschlange in: The sound queue can be disabled in a new firmware above. This is not a live mute command for the connected CU. No automatic flashing takes place.
Sensor- und Tasten-Bestätigungstöne lass: Sensor and button confirmation tones can be disabled on the CU: switch off the CU, hold START/ENTER, switch on the CU, then release the button. Carrera states that the power-on confirmation tone remains. This is a CU setting, not a Bluetooth/USB sound setting.
Für die laufende V339-Verbindung ist kei: No separate mute command is clearly documented for the current V339 connection. Software START/ENTER can start a race; no such button press is sent here to mute the CU.
Ein Patch-Rezept bindet jede Änderung an: A patch recipe binds every change to the exact SHA-256 and expected original bytes. Addresses from 0x3800 onward remain blocked.

Was bedeuten die Freigaben und der Statu: What do the confirmations and status mean?
Erlaubt eine angepasste Datei, deren exa: Allows a modified file whose exact hash is not known as an official reference image. “Unknown” does not automatically mean defective or hardware-validated.
Bestätigt entfernte Fahrzeuge, die richt: Confirms that cars are removed, the CU is correct and the power supply is secured. Confirm only if this is actually true.
Gelten nur im Recovery-Modus. Hardware 5: Apply only in recovery mode. Hardware 5 is required; an interrupted data block must have been discarded by the appropriate bootloader restart.
idle = kein Flash gestartet; writing = D: idle = no flash started; writing = transferring data; verifying = checking restart/responses; complete = transfer and final verification successful; recovery_required = operation incomplete, check recovery. complete does not confirm a full firmware readback.
Die Regler oben zeigen die gewählte Date: The controls above show the selected file, not live CU settings. A completed flash log belongs to the file hash stated in that log.
Während der Übertragung dieses Fenster g: Keep this window open during transfer and do not switch off the CU. After interruption, do not resend automatically: recovery uses a complete image from the first line. Recovery mode has no version handshake before transfer.
Die Abschlussprüfung prüft CU-Version un: Final verification checks the CU version and valid status data. The protocol does not offer byte-by-byte firmware readback.
